notes.title: Capybara Park at Neo Fest 2025
notes.content:
Capybara Park is now officially registered for Steam Neo Fest 2025

This festival will allow us to introduce the game to new players before its final release, which should take place some time afterwards!

To celebrate the fest, the game will have a new demo containing a new Capybara to adopt, Jelly!

notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Our Capybara Park demo is finally available, and you can get it by visiting the dedicated Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3125960/Capybara_Park_Demo/

This demo contains around 45 minutes of gameplay and lets you adopt 4 adorable capybaras in your park.

I hope you enjoy the demo, and if you do, don't hesitate to give us your feedback!

Cédric

notes.title: Some fresh news from Capybara Park #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

It's now been a few days since the Capybara Park page went online, and nearly 250 of you have already joined me in this wonderful adventure!

I'm writing this quick message first of all to thank you for your many messages of support and feedback! (Especially the r/CozyGamers community!).

I'd also like to keep you up to date on several things that will be happening soon:
[list]
[*]The release of our closed demo: you can already sign up by joining [url=https://discord.com/invite/s2hyk6mc8y]our Discord[/url], it's just a matter of weeks!
[*]The release of our open demo at the end of summer on Steam
[*]The first DevLog should be out in two weeks's time.
[/list]

If you have any questions or suggestions, I'd be delighted to hear from you on Discord!
Enjoy these beautiful summer days

Cédric, Capybara Park developer
